{{Quote|Tru'eb is one of the few honorable smugglers I've known. His sense of duty to those crushed by the iron glove of tyranny is true, and Tru'eb has helped supply arms to struggling Rebel cells.|Airen Cracken|<ref name="CRO" />}}
'''Tru'eb Cholakk''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. When his dreams of arming his people against their [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]] was made known, he was exiled from Kala'uun and later [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by [[Quintik Kahr]], a [[Sludir]] criminal who owned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Quincey's Girl]]''. While on the Sludir's ship around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Cholakk encountered [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]], an enslaved [[Human/Legends|Human]] woman who was to be gifted to the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Antoll Jellrek]]. Together, they hatched a plan to free themselves from enslavement and fled from the ship following the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of Kahr and Jellrek.

==Biography==
===Twi'lek tribunal===
{{Quote|Do you wish to speak before the head-clan renders judgment?''"<br/>"''As I have done during this entire tribunal, I once again protest these accusations, as they are brought against me by my cousin, Ku'amar, who stands to take my place as an heir to the head-clan if I am sent from my city.|Tru'eb Cholakk's parent and their son at his tribunal|<ref name="TS" />}}
Tru'eb Cholakk was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="CRO" /> [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] around [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]]<ref name="Birth">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', wherein Tru'eb Cholakk is listed as 28 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, dates itself to the time shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which is dated to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, Cholakk has an approximate birth date of [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].</ref> whose home was [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="CRO" /> He was<ref name="BQ" /> the only<ref name="TS" /> son of a [[Tru'eb Cholakk's parent|head clan member]] for the city and dreamed of achieving his parent's position<ref name="BQ">{{JournalCite|2|Big Quince (short story)}}</ref> when he was young. He also dreamed of arming his people against the [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]] that Kala'uun would pay tribute to.<ref name="CRO" /> Cholakk discussed this with his close associates in his clan,<ref name="TS" /> even though some individuals opposed the idea, as it went against Twi'lek philosophy.<ref name="CRO" /> At some point, Cholakk's cousin, [[Ku'amar]], accused the Twi'lek of challenging the city's ways, leading to him being placed into custody and being found guilty.<ref name="TS" />

[[File:TruebCholakkTrial-PlattsStarportGuide.jpg|thumb|left|400px|Trueb Cholakk (foreground, left) at his tribunal]]
At Cholakk's tribunal, he was brought before Kala'uun's head clan in chains. His parent, the clan head speaker, listed his crimes as poisoning the minds of his peers, challenging their way of life, and fomenting revolt, before he offered his son the chance to speak before his council made their judgement. Straightening himself up, Cholakk brought up the fact that Ku'amar would take his place in the head-clan should he be removed from Kala'uun. His parent responded his protest was invalid, unfounded, and circumstantial.<ref name="TS" /> 

The speaker sentenced his son to exile and [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]], reasoning that Kala'uun could not withstand his lies. Cholakk was led away to an enslaver's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] as the council turned his back on him. Cholakk's parent did not cry for the exile of his son.<ref name="TS" /> Cholakk eventually fell into the grasp of "[[Quintik Kahr|Big Quince]],"<ref name="BQ" /> whose real name was Quintik Kahr.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> Kahr was an infamous enslaver of the [[Sludir]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who kept Cholakk in the slave pens of his starship,'' [[Quincey's Girl]]''. The Sludir offered him the chance to be his personal servant, an opportunity the Twi'lek quickly took up, knowing he would not survive in the slave pens. Though Cholakk faithfully served Kahr and was the only enslaved person allowed in the Sludir's presence, the Twi'lek still perpetually schemed his escape.<ref name="BQ" />

===Enslaved to Big Quince===
====Making a diversion====
{{Quote|Do you have a name?''"<br/>"''What's it to you?''"<br/>"''Do you have some term by which I can refer to you? Something other than slave girl...''"<br/>"''You can call me Oakie.|Trueb Cholakk and Platt Okeefe.|<ref name="BQ" />}}
[[File:QuinceysGirl-SWAJ2.png|thumb|right|300px|Tru'eb Cholakk was ordered by "Big Quince" to retrieve a woman from the slave pens of ''Quincey's Girl''.]]
Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the stories "[[Chessa's Doom]]," "[[Big Quince (short story)|Big Quince]]," "[[Explosive Developments]]," "[[Starter's Tale]]," and "[[Vengeance Strike]]" to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] and their flashback portions to around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Kahr was expecting another visit from [[Antoll Jellrek]], a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]. After calling forward Cholakk on the bridge of his starship, Kahr ordered the Twi'lek to travel down to the slave pens and select an enslaved woman for the Moff. The Sludir specified not to pick Twi'lek women before Cholakk glanced around at the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] on the bridge. Kahr gave his last orders for the chosen enslaved woman to be cleaned up and ready in two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. He acknowledged the command and bowed before walking away and travelling down to the slave pens. There, he chose [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]], a [[Brentaalan|Brentaalian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].<ref name="BQ" />

The pair advanced upwards through the ship to and entered Kahr's cabin, where Cholakk motioned for Okeefe to step towards Kahr's [[Bath/Legends|bath]]. He carefully removed the bound on her wrists and asked her for her name. Okeefe answered back with her nickname, "Oakie." In return, Cholakk told her to bathe and dress herself in the provided [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. As the woman bathed, he examined the four crates of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] near Kahr's bar, then stared around at the riches in the cabin.<ref name="BQ" />

[[File:Bathroom-SWAJ2.png|thumb|left|350px|Tru'eb Cholakk examined ryll spice while Platt Okeefe bathed.]]
Cholakk stopped his staring when Okeefe stepped out of the bath and asked him why he worked for Kahr. After explaining he was enslaved, she offered him the chance to escape together. Thinking Okeefe meant that they would escape at their current moment, he provided the reasons to not do so until Okeefe cut him off and learned from him for what Kahr planned for her&mdash;Okeefe and the ryll crates would be gifted to Jellrek. She then worked out a plan and found a bottle of [[Gruvian Tovash]] and Kahr's [[Sludir soap]]. After Cholakk opened one of the crates for her, she stuck the bottle on the top of the crate's lid with the soap in manner so that when opened, the ryll would react with the Tovash and produce smoke that would provide a diversion as they ran towards the Moff's shuttle. After learning the plan and mentally noting the crate's markings, Cholakk retied Okeefe's hands, this time in an easily undone knot. Enslavers then entered and ushered them to the docking bay with the shuttle.<ref name="BQ" />

====Making an escape====
{{Quote|You've never flown a starship, have you?''"<br/>"''You are very observant.|Platt Okeefe and Tru'eb Cholakk|<ref name="BQ" />}}
[[File:MoffVisit-SWAJ2.png|thumb|right|350px|Tru'eb Cholakk and Platt Okeefe (right) waited for their smoke diversion while Moff Jellrek looked over his ryll spice.]]
Cholakk and Okeefe arrived at the docking bay shortly after the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class shuttle]] carrying the Moff landed. When Kahr introduced Okeefe to Jellrek, Cholakk led the woman forward by her bounds. After looking her over, the Moff redirected his attention to the ryll and ordered it opened. Noticing one of the Moff's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]] opening the crate with the markings, Cholakk looked towards Okeefe, who was already gazing at the shuttle's boarding ramp.<ref name="BQ" />

When the smoke emerged from the open crate and engulfed their surroundings, Okeefe untied herself and strangled a stormtrooper. Concurrently, the Twi'lek kicked a stormtrooper in their chest. The two then made their way up the shuttle's boarding ramp and assumed control of the ship, using its armament to fire through the smoke.<ref name="BQ" /> During the fighting, Kahr and Jellrek were both [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|154|Jellrek, Antoll}}</ref>

After taking flight nearby an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]], Cholakk was ordered by Okeefe to jam communications of the shuttle. The Twi'lek, who had never flown before this, fumbled with the ship's controls and powered up their [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], causing his new partner to flip the correct switch for him. She asked if he had ever flown before, to which he sarcastically replied that she was observant. Okeefe then told him she would have to teach him about ships once free, and for him to wait until she found [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] coordinates. Their shuttle was then hit by ''Quincey's Girl'', leading Cholakk to question whether they had actually jammed their communication. On the orders of Okeefe, the Twi'lek found the controls to raise the aft shields just before they were shot at. Okeefe then sent the ship into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], allowing them to escape their perusers.<ref name="BQ" />

===Tru'eb the gunrunner===
{{Quote|Now Tru'eb plies the space lanes of the Outer Rim Territories and Mid Rim, making arms deals and smuggling weapons to those in need, including Rebels.|Airen Cracken|<ref name="CRO" />}}
[[File:CRO-LuudrianStar.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Tru'eb Cholakk acquired the light freighter ''Luudrian Star'' (pictured) with help from Platt Okeefe.]]
Following their escape, Okeefe became fast friends with Cholakk<ref name="SOT">{{GalaxyCite|10|Sandbound on Tatooine}}</ref> and aided the man in buying the ''[[Luudrian Star]]'', a modified [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Gthroc Industries]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]. Cholakk also helped her get funding for her new starship, ''[[Pok's Demise]]'', an act which Okeefe repaid by teaching the Twi'lek what she had learned smuggling.<ref name="SOT" /> Cholakk became a gunrunner, aptly known as "Tru'eb the gunrunner,"<ref name="SOT" /> and supplied numerous emerging<ref name="BQ" /> and struggling<ref name="GOI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref> groups of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="BQ" /> He also helped out those in need around the Outer Rim and [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="CRO" /> such as worlds in conflict, which the Twi'lek sought out to help the oppressed people living there.<ref name="GOI" />

Several differing accounts of Cholakk's and Okeefe's escape from Kahr emerged some time afterwards. One story stated that the pair destroyed ''Quincey's Girl'', and another stated Cholakk killed Jullrek during his escape. Both were untrue and the true story was kept with the escapees.<ref name="BQ" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Alliance General [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] profiled him on a datafile mentioning various Rebel operatives he considered useful. On the file, the then twenty-eight-year-old gunrunner's current location was listed as the Outer Rim and Mid Rim.<ref name="CRO" /> 

===Working with Black Curs===
Cholakk would also work with the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group [[Black Curs]] under the leadership of [[Dirk Harkness]]. While on a reconnaissance mission in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], he and the rest of the Black Curs were shot down over the planet [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]]. While Harkness went to look for help, Cholakk stayed behind with the [[Last Chance (YT-1300 light freighter)/Legends|''Last Chance'']] to defend the ship and assist with repairs. After his colleague Platt Okeefe was captured by Golthan and taken to his stronghold, Cholakk recruited some beings to assist in a rescue mission. He flew them to the Black Curs' base and gave them a briefing on their plans to rescue Okeefe. After the group was able to infiltrate and bring down the defenses of Golthan's base, Cholakk flew his freighter to extract the team.<ref name="BCB">{{JournalCite|8|Black Curs Blues}}</ref>

Cholakk was present at [[Gorkin's Rest]] when Harkness told the tale of how he lost the love of his life [[Chessa Dohhenty]] and joined the Rebels.<ref name="AJ1">{{JournalCite|1|Chessa's Doom}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tru'eb Cholakk first appeared in "[[Chessa's Doom]]," a short story written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and illustrated by [[John Paul Lona]]. The story was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|first issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[February]] [[1994]].<ref name="Chessa'sDoom">{{JournalCite|1|Chessa's Doom}}</ref>
